Although, I know the word of liar and a fake Jedi may not mean much to you.''"
"''It's good enough for me.|Haja Estree and Obi-Wan Kenobi|{{Kenobi|Part VI}}}} '''Haja Estree''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[con artist]] who worked on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. A master of illusion, Estree ran a scam on Daiyu where he convinced people he was one of the [[Jedi]]—[[Force-sensitive]] peacekeepers that had been [[Great Jedi Purge|hunted]] and [[Death|killed]] by the Empire—and helped those in need in exchange for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for his services. He partnered with the [[Youngling|young]] boy [[Jayco]] who would find potential clients and lead them to Estree. Estree helped a [[Nyche|mother]] and her [[Corran|son]] get off Daiyu while former [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] watched. Kenobi approached Estree and told him he required his services in [[Search for Princess Leia|finding]] a [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] girl, the [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Estree agreed to help after Kenobi uncovered his scam and directed Kenobi to a [[The Den|spice den]]. Shortly after, when the [[Inquisitor]] [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] put a [[bounty]] on Kenobi, Jayco informed Estree of the bounty, and they went to locate him. Estree found Kenobi and Organa, but not before [[bounty hunter]] [[droid]] [[1-JAC]] came up behind the pair. Estree shot 1-JAC and gave Kenobi instructions to get to a [[Transport eight|cargo transport]] that would lead to the planet [[Mapuzo]]. Kenobi reluctantly agreed, and Estree informed him he was not alone and said he would try to delay the Inquisitors as long as possible. Estree found the Third Sister in an alley, but she quickly realized he was not a Jedi before [[Mind probe (Force power)|probing]] his [[Brain|mind]] for Kenobi's location. Now wanted by the Empire, Estree headed for the planet [[Jabiim]], where he regrouped with members and refugees of [[Hidden Path|The Path]]—an anti-Imperial network that sheltered Jedi and force-sensitive beings—as well as Kenobi and Organa. Estree watched over Organa at the request of Kenobi after the latter had gone on to face the Third Sister. After the [[Attack on Jabiim|Imperial raid]] on the facility and the subsequent escape from the planet, the members of the Path fled from the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]'' and [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. Kenobi decided to part ways with the Path to buy them [[time]], and Estree promised he would get Organa back [[Alderaan|home]]. Estree also comforted Organa after she grew angry with Kenobi for leaving her. ==Biography== ===Con artist with morality=== {{Quote|This is a Jedi mind trick. Do not be alarmed. I'm inside your mind.|Haja Estree imitates a Jedi|}} [[File:mind.png|thumb|right|285px|Haja Estree posed as a Jedi.]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Haja Estree resided on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]], working as a [[con artist]]. In his scam, he posed as one of the [[Jedi]], [[Force-sensitive]] peace-keepers who were [[Great Jedi Purge|hunted]] by the Empire after their [[Jedi Order]] was [[Order 66|destroyed]]{{Kenobi|Part I}} in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' even though he knew it was dangerous.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|subset=Heroes|cardname=Haja Estree|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/365340/cid/21460673}} Helping those in need in return for a sum of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], his performance as a Jedi included using remotes to close the shutters of his [[Unidentified building (Haja Estree)|building]] and [[magnet]]s to summon his [[comlink]] to create an illusion of using [[the Force]]. The con man also employed the help of the boy{{SW|url=series/obi-wan-kenobi/part-ii-guide|text=Part II Episode Guide | Obi-Wan Kenobi}} [[Jayco]] as well as a [[Haja Estree's contact|contact]] at a [[Daiyu spaceport|spaceport]] on Daiyu, whom he could pretend to use a Jedi [[mind trick]] on over his comlink and "convince" him to give individuals safe passage through the port. In the meantime, Estree maintained ties with an anti-Imperial network known as "[[Hidden Path|the Path]]." The Path used a series of safehouses to smuggle real Force-sensitives, who were thus fugitives of the Empire, to the [[Outer Rim Territories]][[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] planet''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' of [[Jabiim]] to receive new identities to go into hiding. He notably had contact with [[Captain]] [[Tala Durith]],{{Kenobi|Part IV}} an undercover [[Imperial officer]] on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[mining]] planet [[Mapuzo]] who had become disillusioned with the Empire and chose to help with the network. ===Meeting Kenobi=== {{Quote|You're not gonna tell anyone, are you?''"
"''That depends on what you tell me.|Haja Estree and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} In [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II}} Estree helped the Force-sensitive child [[Corran]] and his [[Parent|mother]], [[Nyche]],''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' flee Daiyu, pretending to use the Force to trick his contact into letting the pair through to a [[transport]] to the planet [[Corellia]] at [[Gate 3-C]]. Corran's [[Parent|mother]] complimented Estree's apparent Force abilities and [[Currency|paid]] him all of her credits for his services. Estree then urged Corran and his mother away to their transport before informing his contact that he would take a quick break once the pair had left. [[File:Haja_and_ben.png|thumb|left|285px|Kenobi uncovered Estree's scam, forcing the con man to help him.]] Unbeknownst to Estree, [[Jedi Master]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had been led to his lair by Jayco and was watching the encounter from the edge of the room. Kenobi asked Estree to [[Search for Princess Leia|locate]] the [[Alderaanian]] Princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], who had been [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] by the [[Black Mask]] mercenary gang, and Estree asked for a sum of 800 crdits for the job. After Kenobi revealed the con artist's magnetic devices, Estree was forced to help the Jedi, pointing him in the direction of a [[The Den|spice den]] was located. Using Estree's information, the Jedi infiltrated the [[spice]] den and extracted Organa. However, the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], a member of the Empire's Jedi-[[hunting]] organization of the [[Inquisitorius]], had also arrived to [[Hunt for Obi-Wan|hunt]] Kenobi and chose to send out a [[bounty]] on the Jedi across Daiyu's [[Daiyu City|city]] to help find her target. ===Making amends=== {{Quote|Go to these coordinates. They'll help you from there.''"
"''And how do I know this isn't just a trap?''"
"''What choice do you have?|Haja Estree offers to help Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:Haja_and_reva.png|thumb|right|285px|Estree faced the Third Sister after talking with Kenobi.]] Estree then tried to help get Kenobi to the anti-Imperial network on Mapuzo. The con artist caught up with the Jedi Master and Organa at an alleyway near the [[spaceport]], gunning down the [[bounty hunter]] [[droid]] [[1-JAC]] before it could attack the pair. Kenobi believed Estree was coming for his bounty, but the con man instead gave him instructions to go to an automated cargo port and use a [[tracking fob]] to take the [[TR-286 transport|TR-286]] [[transport eight]] to Mapuzo. Shortly afterward, Estree cornered the Third Sister in an alley, continuing his act as a Jedi. The Inquisitor quickly figured out he was not one but still knew where Kenobi was. She [[Mind probe (Force power)|probed]] his [[Brain|mind]] with the Force and found where he had sent Kenobi, leaving Estree in the alley to pursue her target. ===Escape from Jabiim=== {{Quote|You're going to fight him?''"
"''He expects me to surrender. He knows I'll do everything I can to protect these people.|Haja Estree and Obi-Wan Kenobi before Kenobi surrenders on Jabiim|}} Following his encounter with the Third Sister, Estree became wanted by the Empire and arrived on Jabiim. When Kenobi arrived with [[Kawlan Roken]]—a leader of the Path—from [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|rescuing Organa]] from the Inquisitors' [[Fortress Inquisitorius|fortress]], Kenobi greeted Estree, who joked that the Path headquarters was a good business place. After the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Devastator]]''—the flagship of [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]—arrived over Jabiim, Estree worked with the other refugees locking down all the entrances of the facility. At Kenobi's request, Estree kept an eye on Organa while she delved into the vents trying to open the main hangar door.{{Kenobi|Part V}} [[File:Haja_and_bens_stuff.png|thumb|left|285px|Before confronting the Third Sister and Vader, Kenobi gave Estree his belongings.]] While Estree watched Organa, the Third Sister and her forces [[Attack on Jabiim|attacked]] the facility in hopes of capturing Kenobi, which resulted in a number of deaths on both sides. Tala Durith used her blaster to close off one of the [[blast door]]s to the main [[hangar]] before she sacrificed herself. After the attack halted, Kenobi agreed to surrender to the Third Sister and Vader. Before he left to fight Vader, the Jedi handed Estree his [[lightsaber]], blaster, and [[imagecaster]]. After Organa opened up the hangar bay doors, Estree dropped Kenobi's imagecaster while running to the transport. A decoy transport took off from the base, which Darth Vader pulled down with the Force before the true transport made its escape. Following the escape, the Third Sister found Kenobi's imagecaster that Estree had dropped. Fleeing Jabiim, the transport possessed a faulty [[hyperdrive]] and was pursued by the ''Devastator''. As a result, Kenobi decided he would part ways with the refugees as it would give Roken time to fix the ship and escape, much to Organa's anger. Estree advised Kenobi to give Organa some space and promised he would get Organa to her home planet of [[Alderaan]] as soon as Kenobi was clear. Estree also spoke to Organa, consoling her before Kenobi returned to speak to her and say his farewells. Kenobi and Organa later regrouped on Alderaan. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Look, have I made a few bad decisions? Sure. Do I feel bad about it? Sometimes. Do I like credits? Yeah. So much stuff you can buy with credits.|Haja Estree to Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:HajaEstree-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|220px|Haja Estree was able to convince marks he was a Jedi through trickery and slight of hand.]] As a criminal and conman, Estree's motivation for his scam was to attain more credits. He enlisted the help of Jayco, who found potential clients and led them to his lair, using magnets and remotes to sell his fake Jedi scam. Though Estree cared about making his operations profitable, he also assured that the people he scammed would find safety among the Path. Estree carried a fake lightsaber that he created{{HomeVideoCite|set=Obi-Wan Kenobi: The Complete Series|featurette=Designing the Galaxy}} at his hip on the outside of his [[robe]]s, whereas most Jedi concealed their lightsabers underneath their [[Jedi apparel|robes]]. He later decided to help Kenobi escape, saying that he wanted to make amends, and faced the Third Sister to give him and Organa more time to flee. Despite his criminal activities and lies,{{Databank|haja-estree|Haja Estree}} Estree's goals were not malicious.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars Chrome|cardname=Haja Estree|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/362798/cid/21367046}} He genuinely wanted to help Kenobi and gained a newfound respect for real Jedi after meeting the man. He was also devoted to the Path, keeping in touch with Tala Durith on Jabiim, although he indicated that the Path's headquarters was a good location to conduct his scam. Estree later assisted The Path in escaping from Jabiim, finally earning Kenobi's trust. Estree had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light-colored skin. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|Now I know what it feels like being a real Jedi. It's not easy.|Estree, to Kenobi|}} Estree was regarded as master of illusion, and owned a blaster pistol with which he was capable. Although his scam was centered around him being a Jedi, Estree was not Force-sensitive. ==Equipment== {{Quote|What do you know of the Force, my friend?''"
"''Just that it's a bunch of remotes and magnets.|Obi-Wan Kenobi uncovers Haja Estree's ruse|}} Estree used a modified remote door opener to close the shutters of the building to make it look like he was using the Force, as well as magnets to summon his comlink. He also carried a fake lightsaber on his hip, and owned a blaster pistol. The con artist wore brown trousers with an off-white undershirt covered by a dark green tunic and a brown, [[carbon-cotton]] belt. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|His name is Haja, and he's this guy who works on the streets of Daiyu, which is this new Star Wars location that we haven't seen before that's absolutely gorgeous. And he's the guy who's worked really hard to stay out of the bigger conflicts at play. He just kind of wants to be his own guy. Survival for him is all that matters.|Kumail Nanjiani|{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/obi-wan-kenobi-kumail-nanjiani-haja-star-wars|text=Kumail Nanjiani shares first details of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' con-man character Haja|author=Ross, Dalton|date=2022-05-20|archivedate=20220311122528}}}} [[File:Haja.bts.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Kumail Nanjiani as Haja Estree on the set of ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']] Portrayed by [[Kumail Nanjiani]], whose stunt double was [[Brennan Mejia]], Haja Estree first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which aired on [[May 26]], 2022.{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} The character was teased beforehand as well, first being mentioned in an interview with Nanjiani and later being shown in the teaser trailer for the series, which was released on [[March 9]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} Writer [[Joby Harold]] felt that having a fake Jedi would be a fun thing to add to ''[[Star Wars]]'', leading to the creation of the con artist Haja Estree. Estree was shown pretending to use the Force to close the shutters in the second episode to make it clear that he's a fraud. Harold wanted that scene because director [[J.J. Abrams]] told him it should be a massive moment when Jedi use the Force, and it must be earned.{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2022/06/obi-wan-kenobi-explained|text=''Obi-Wan Kenobi:'' Darth Vader Was Originally Even More Terrifying|author=Breznican, Anthony|date=2022-06-03|work=[[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair (magazine)|''Vanity Fair'']]|archivedate=20220603154447}} Nanjiani landed the role after director [[Deborah Chow]] pitched the project to him and he agreed. [[File:KumailNanjiani.png|thumb|left|250px|Kumail Nanjiani spent time preparing for his role as Haja Estree, finding it fun to portray the character.]] To prepare for his role, Nanjiani re-watched all the ''Star Wars'' films, as well as looked up different techniques that con-men used to scam their marks. The actor believed it was very fun to portray a con-man in the context of ''Star Wars'', as well as playing a fake Jedi in general.''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' Nanjiani did much research on con men and magicians to learn how to play a character like Estree.{{WebCite|url=https://www.syfy.com/syfy-wire/kumail-nanjiani-explains-his-new-character-in-obi-wan-kenobi|text='Eternals' star Kumail Nanjiani reveals his 'street-level' new character in 'Obi-Wan Kenobi'|author=Matthew Jackson|date=2022-05-20|work=[[Wikipedia:Syfy|Syfy]]|archivedate=20230301115719}} The actor considered working on a ''Star Wars'' project a "dream come true."{{YouTube|video=Vpkku4DcykE|text=What Kumail Nanjiani Did on His 1st Day on 'Obi-Wan Kenobe' with Ewan McGregor|channel=@RichEisenShow|name=The Rich Eisen Show}} The actor described the character as a "street-level con-man guy who then gets embroiled in stuff that's way too big for him," who used a lot of gadgets to fool others.{{HomeVideoCite|set=Obi-Wan Kenobi: The Complete Series|featurette=Designing the Galaxy}}, "[[Part VI]]" Nanjiani elaborated that Estree had a complicated morality, with a "pull and push inside of him," choosing between doing the right thing and making money, which made the choice he eventually makes much richer. In production, the show's propmaster [[Brad Elliott]] and other production staff decided that Estree's lightsaber should look rudimentary and only passable as one of the weapons from a distance, reflecting that he was not a true Jedi. He tasked several prop makers with making a lightsaber for Estree with a budget of fifty dollars and a day and a half of time, instructing them to use materials from a hardware store and intentionally make it "bad." However, Elliott felt that each of the lightsabers produced turned out "too good" due to the talent of his team. Eventually, the lightsabers from the propmakers were presented to Chow{{WebCite|url=https://www.boomplay.com/episode/6054620|text=PMG Presents: Props of the Star Wars Shows - Recorded Live from LA Comic Con 2023|author=Prop Talk|date=2023-12-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Boomplay|Boomplay]]|archivedate=20250121011832}} and designer{{SW|url=news/doug-chiang-interview|text="There is a Strength in Asian Culture": A Conversation with Lucasfilm Legend Doug Chiang}} [[Doug Chiang]], alongside one prop lightsaber Elliott had made for his [[Wikipedia:Halloween|Halloween]] out of hardware store materials when he was in his twenties. Though Elliott considered his costume lightsaber not to be good quality, Chiang and Chow picked it for Estree to use in the show. The propmaster was shocked but nonetheless thrilled that a piece of his past had become canon, having only originally intended it for use at a costume party. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images
